title: Umusimbura washyizweho
intro: Umuntu wo mu bihe byashize yari yiteguye kwinjira mu mateka. Ubwo inzira yasaga n'aho idasobanutse neza kandi gushidikanya kukaba kwarakwirakwiriye mu bantu, uwo mugaragu yatoranijwe gufata umwambaro w'ubuyobozi. Bafite umutwaro w'ubutumwa bwera ku bitugu byabo, bateye intambwe bajya imbere aho abandi batindaga gukurikira.
clues: Natoranijwe kujyana n'umuhanuzi kandi nize ku bwenge bwabo
Nahagaze imbere y'Isanduku ubwo isezerano ry'Uwaduhaye ryari ryegereje, maze mbona abantu batangira gushidikanya
Nashyizweho mpagaze ku nkengero z'ibyo nari nasezeranijwe mu gihe umuyobozi wacu yari afite agahinda kandi adusabira ku Mana
Nashinzwe gukomeza ubutumwa bwari bwarahawe undi muntu wabanjirije
Nahawe ububasha bw'Imana bwo kuyobora abantu kugera aho bajya
Nashoboye kurangiza ibyari byaratangiye mbere yanjye, kandi abantu banyemeza ko ndi umuyobozi

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
